The skin depth ($\delta$) is given by the formula:
$$\delta = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\omega \mu \sigma}} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{\pi f \mu \sigma}}$$

Given data:
- Frequency $f = 3.0 \times 10^6 \text{ Hz}$
- Conductivity $\sigma = 38.0 \times 10^6 \text{ S/m}$
- Permeability $\mu = \mu_r \mu_0 = 1 \times (4\pi \times 10^{-7} \text{ H/m}) = 4\pi \times 10^{-7} \text{ H/m}$

Substitute the values into the formula:
$$\delta = \sqrt{\frac{1}{\pi \times (3.0 \times 10^6) \times (4\pi \times 10^{-7}) \times (38.0 \times 10^6)}}$$
$$\delta = \sqrt{\frac{1}{1.2007 \times 10^3}} = \sqrt{8.328 \times 10^{-4}} \approx 0.0288 \text{ m} = 2.88 \text{ cm}$$
proTip: Watch out for unit conversions and ensure $\mu_0 = 4\pi \times 10^{-7}$ is correctly incorporated with $\mu_r$.
